In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evidence for a relationship between dietary fat and cancer of the large bowel is strong, but that there is no evidence of such a relationship in cancer of the breast, endometrial or prostate.
dietary fat is probably an important etiologic factor in the causation, and in the prevention, of human cancer.
there is good evidence for a role for dietary fat in the etiology of cancers of the colon and breast, and some evidence that it may be important in endometrial and prostate cancers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is good evidence from epidemiological studies that dietary fat is a risk factor in the causation in humans of cancer of the large bowel and breast, and probably of endometrium and prostate.
the evidence that fat is a cause of cancer of the large bowel is very strong, but that for cancers of the breast, endometrial and prostate is weaker and for stomach cancer is very weak.
the evidence that dietary fats are important in the etiology of human cancer is strong, but that the evidence that they are the most important dietary factor in the etiology is not yet conclusive.
